content.title: QNB (QNBC) Profit Margin Jump Challenges Bearish Narratives on Core Bank Model
content.summary: QNB (QNBC) delivered a net profit margin of 24.1%, up from 20.2% last year, and posted earnings growth of 38.1% over the last year, bucking a five-year average decline of 7% per year. With shares trading at $34.74 and a Price-To-Earnings ratio of 9.8x, both below peer and industry averages, the market has yet to fully price in these improved results.
